origin: Kevin: 'eastGate enumerate self — make JUST THE ONE organism — it's 1 YEAST CELL, the eukaryote!'
identity: eastGate = Saccharomyces cerevisiae (brewer's yeast) = simplest eukaryote

nucleus.analogy: The nucleus holds the genome and controls all cell activity

mitochondria.function: ATP production = TFLOPS. The powerhouse of the cell.
mitochondria.analogy: Mitochondria convert fuel to energy. GPU converts data to inference.

endoplasmic_reticulum.function: Protein folding = pattern classification. Rough ER = spiking inference.
endoplasmic_reticulum.analogy: ER folds proteins into shape. NPU folds data into classifications.

cytoplasm.function: The fluid medium. All reactions happen here.
cytoplasm.analogy: Cytoplasm fills the cell. RAM fills the space between CPU and disk.

vacuole.analogy: Yeast vacuoles store nutrients and regulate pressure. Disk stores data.

cell_membrane.hardware: 3 NICs: enp5s0(.244), wlp0s20f3(WiFi), eno1(DOWN) + docker0 + virbr0
cell_membrane.function: Selective permeability. What enters, what leaves.
cell_membrane.analogy: The membrane controls I/O. Network interfaces control packet flow.

golgi_apparatus.function: Package proteins, tag them, ship them to the right destination
golgi_apparatus.analogy: Golgi sorts and routes. Services sort and route requests.

ribosomes.analogy: Each process IS a ribosome translating mRNA (code) into protein (output)

lysosomes.analogy: Cron jobs digest old data, recycle resources, clean up waste

flagella.analogy: Flagella propel and sense. Tor/BT/USB are extensions into the world.

genome.analogy: Every .rs file is a gene. Every .json is an expressed protein. Every .html is a phenotype.

why_yeast.fermentation: Yeast FERMENTS — sourDough! The stoichiometry engine IS yeast metabolism!
why_yeast.budding: Yeast reproduces by BUDDING — one cell grows a smaller cell. Gates are BUDS.
why_yeast.triple_point: Yeast lives at the triple point: sugar(solid) + water(liquid) + CO2(gas)
why_yeast.beer_and_bread: Humanity's oldest biotech. 10,000 years. The organism that feeds civilization.

one_cell: This is ONE yeast cell. eastGate. All organelles inside. The other gates are daughter cells, budded off. But THIS is the original. The mother cell.
